data.name: Zbigniew
data.gender_notes: Zbigniew is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Slavic roots ‘zbīg’ meaning ‘to exalt, glorify, or dedicate,’ and ‘niew’ meaning ‘new, youthful, or gracious giver.’ The name Zbigniew reflects the dedication of an individual to a higher power or cause. The name Zbigniew carries the meaning “Exalted, Dedicated, Gracious Giver” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Zbigniew usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, dedicated, gracious giver and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zbigniew total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
